actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Completely NEW finished four-panel Bunny HEAD GOGGLE WEARING reference board, clean Japanese hand-drawn dark ink + hard CEL colour, white background. 2x2 four busts, same human head size: FRONT RAISED / STRICT RIGHT SIDE RAISED (face screen RIGHT) / BACK RAISED / FRONT LOWERED. Full hair within frame and short labels only. Re-draw the entire board fresh.
REFERENCES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
1 current BASE front head is sole front identity, face/eyes/nose/chin/hair and skin/style authority.
2 object-only assembled goggles is the WHITE rounded narrow frame / SINGLE continuous smoke lens / charcoal gasket /2 small orange connector shape authority. No human wearing offset is supplied.
3 previous RIGHT SIDE raised head is accepted side identity/pose and especially the SLENDER black elastic strap width and narrow forehead-goggle height authority.
4 previous BACK raised head is accepted rear hair/identity and especially the THIN black strap width/path authority.
5 current collar only: normal black collar, white top, orange/red shoulders.
Preserve these accepted light proportions. DO NOT make a bulkier, taller visor or wider head strap in order to align the front. No new device design.

CRITICAL FRONT ALIGNMENT: both front head poses are straight-on with level eye baseline and the same unaltered face as ref1. Imagine a facial axis through pupil midpoint, glabella/nose tip/philtrum/chin. The center of the FRAME'S nasal relief, the middle of its upper rim and the midpoint between its TWO orange side connectors must all lie on this exact FACE axis. Corresponding left/right rim points and both orange connectors are equally high relative to the eyes and equally distant from the axis. Keep actual lens/frame contour symmetric and level. The hairstyle part/cowlick/fringe is OFFSET and is NOT the facial axis! Never center on the hair part. Never shift/tilt/reshape eyes or face to accommodate an off-center goggle.
FRAME HEIGHT: maintain the light, NARROW original goggles, approximately 3.3–3.5 units wide for1 unit total outer height in the frontal wearing drawing, not a tall mask. Same broad softly rounded lobes/low nose relief/white rim and two small orange side connectors as ref2; do not sharpen corners. Reduce vertical bulk rather than narrowing the whole frame. Keep fit across brow, not oversized beyond temples.
STRAP WIDTH: one THIN BLACK ELASTIC strip, matching references3/4. At a similar head size its exposed rear strip is about20–23 drawing pixels thick, not33–40; this is an illustration proportion cue, not a physical measurement or label. At all four views maintain the same slender strap visual weight. Do not exaggerate the woven rib texture or soften it into noisy grain. Circumferential strap connects DIRECTLY frame-side small orange connectors to around side and back of skull. No rigid arms/pivots, no headband/crown arch, no bunny ears/clips, no headphone cups/pads/pods/microphone, no rear buckle. Hair on crown completely free. Topology remains exactly one frame/lens/gasket, one strap and two small side connectors.

DAILY raised: physically slide the entire goggles+strap UP onto forehead above eyebrows. Both blue eyes completely visible. Side must match ref3's direct connector→soft band→posterior path, with natural attached human ear below. Rear must match ref4's one SLENDER band across occipital hair, no lens on rear and no extra strap. Side's normal fore-high/posterior-low wrapping angle is allowed.
ACTION lowered: same goggles moved to the eyes, centered on the same face axis; not hinging off a forehead mount, no spare hardware stays on forehead. Smoke lens allows subdued eyes behind it like selected design; nose tip, mouth, chin free. Keep same narrow frame/strap proportions. Silver hair may naturally overlap some frame/band, without shifting the actual frame or carving holes in it.
Hair silver-white with broad continuous cool-gray hard shadow groups and dark clean outline; blue irises, natural narrow attached human ears and peach skin. No flesh-coloured hair, floating ears, face changes, cloudy hair noise/white specks/soft blur/waxy skin. Current normal black collar/white inner top/orange jacket shoulders/red lapel corners. Harness under jacket. No OG neck ring/new logo/long text/dimensions/manufacturing claims. Invisible axes and ratio cues are instruction only, never draw them.

method: builtin imagegen; complete fresh drawing; byte-exact native; lossless WebP only
